phases.objective: Implement an unmounted read-only Tenant projection over canonical durable SQL state with audience-first authorization and explicit redaction of filesystem, worker, connector, host-key, snapshot, inode, and internal evidence references.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Tenant-safe Durable Projection Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A Tenant receives a digest-bound durable summary of its exact operation, plan, run, authority, enablement, journal counts, and latest reconciliation without receiving paths, item identities, worker or connector references, host-key or snapshot references, raw evidence hashes, provider payloads, or secrets.
steps: Require the canonical verified SQL composition with one canonical run-read facet.
Require canonical durable Tenant authority and one-shot enablement dependencies bound to the same database fingerprint.
Read the operation aggregate first and reject any Tenant, Workspace, Resource, context-mode, or operation mismatch before secondary reads.
Read the exact run, allowlist, approval, enablement, and immutable consumption receipt only after the audience gate passes.
Verify operation-to-plan, operation-plan-to-run, target-to-allowlist, Workspace Owner approval, and operation-run enablement bindings.
Verify that the current consumed state agrees with immutable consumption-receipt presence.
Reduce journal rows to phase and outcome counts and reduce reconciliation rows to the latest outcome and retry semantics.
Expose only bounded Tenant identifiers, state, counts, timestamps, and safe digests while applying the explicit redaction list.
Fail the test when any sensitive fixture value appears in serialized output.
Keep the projector read-only, unmounted, non-provider, and non-production.
assertions: Audience mismatch stops after the aggregate read and before run, authority, approval, enablement, or receipt reads.
All durable dependencies bind the same database fingerprint.
Run, allowlist, approval, enablement, and receipt mismatches fail closed.
Raw journal, reconciliation, and run metadata rows are never exposed.
Path, worker, connector, dispatch-certification, host-key, snapshot, inode, device, timestamp-stat, ownership, and internal evidence references are absent from serialized output.
Retry is true only for a latest not_applied reconciliation with explicit retry permission and always requires a fresh read.
Factory construction performs zero durable reads and exposes no raw dependency.
No route, server, worker, migration, provider, Hostinger, deployment, main, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Use the projection from the async Tenant runtime bridge only after authority and enablement DDL promotion/apply, signed live verification, dependency injection, and mount authorization.
blockers: Authority-store and enablement-registry DDL remain contract-local and unapplied.
No signed live verification exists for those two durable stores.
The async Tenant runtime bridge has not been created or mounted.

phases.objective: Prove restart reconstruction, partial journal sequences, multiple reconciliation versions, missing receipts, stale schema provenance, and cross-Tenant denial under concurrent writes.
This code-only projection performs no live Tenant, database, or provider canary.
Production route exposure and provider execution remain separately governed and blocked.
